title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn
seo_title: Springfield Symphony: An American Hymn, Feb 13, 2027
description: An American Hymn is a Springfield Symphony Orchestra concert of sacred works by American composers, including Bernstein's Chichester Psalms with the Combined University Choirs, Copland's Appalachian Spring, and Jessie Montgomery's Starburst. It takes place on Saturday, February 13, 2027 at 7:30 PM at the Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts, 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO. Tickets are sold only through HammonsHall.com or MissouriStateTix.com.
venue: Juanita K. Hammons Hall for the Performing Arts
